title: UniversalBox
desc: Box with various options for different styles and lids

items.name: FingerJoint_style

items.label: height

items.desc: height of hole(s) in percentage of maximum hole height (handle height - 2 * material thickness)

items.name: HandleEdge_hole_width
items.label: hole_width

items.name: HandleEdge_radius

items.name: Lid_brim_spacing

items.label: handle

items.name: Lid_brim_height

items.name: Lid_fang_size
items.label: fang_size

items.name: Lid_handle_height
items.label: handle_height
items.desc: height of the handle in multiples of thickness (if applicable)

items.name: Lid_height
items.label: height
items.desc: height of the brim in multiples of thickness (if any)

items.name: Lid_play
items.label: play
items.desc: play when sliding the lid on in multiples of thickness (if applicable)

items.name: top_edge
items.label: top_edge
items.desc: edge type for top edge
options: Š Stackable edge with finger holes (top)
i Straight edge with hinge eye
k Straight edge with hinge eye (both ends)
v Edge with cabinet hinges for 90° lid
L Edge for slide on lid (box back)
G Edge with pear shaped mounting holes
y Handle for e.g. a drawer
Y Handle with holes for parallel finger joint

items.name: bottom_edge
items.label: bottom_edge
items.desc: edge type for bottom edge

items.name: x
items.label: x
items.desc: inner width in mm (unless outside selected)

items.name: y
items.label: y
items.desc: inner depth in mm (unless outside selected)

items.name: h
items.label: h
items.desc: inner height in mm (unless outside selected)

items.name: outside
items.label: outside
items.desc: treat sizes as outside measurements

items.name: vertical_edges
items.label: vertical_edges
items.desc: connections used for the vertical edges

items.name: thickness
items.label: thickness
items.desc: thickness of the material (in mm)

items.name: burn
items.label: burn
items.desc: burn correction (in mm)(bigger values for tighter fit)

items.name: format
items.label: format
items.desc: format of resulting file

items.name: labels
items.label: labels
items.desc: label the parts (where available)

items.name: reference
items.label: reference
items.desc: print reference rectangle with given length (in mm)(zero to disable)

items.name: tabs
items.label: tabs

items.name: qr_code

items.name: inner_corners

items.label: spacing
